original.statement: In v3, the status code reported in metrics for gRPC requests is now the value of the Grpc-Status header.

decision.reason: [ev-aaffdc720dda] says that in v3 the status code reported in metrics for gRPC requests is now the value of the `Grpc-Status` header. That is a change in runtime semantics, not a renamed or removed setting, so behavior-changed fits. The subject name grpc-metrics-status-code is made only from the evidence's own key words. The evidence does not say what the earlier value was, so it is right to leave "before" unset (P2's HTTP-status-code "before" has no support), and "after" matches the text apart from small differences in wording.
